ideas.pitch: An offline-first AR mobile workflow designed to guide new students around the BFIT campus and instantly onboard them to campus digital services.
ideas.title: CampusAR Navigation & Facility Onboarding
ideas.why_it_could_win: Campus judges love practical utilities they can immediately test on their own phones walking around the BFIT campus.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision web tool tailored for local cricket enthusiasts in Dehradun to analyze batting postures using pose estimation.
ideas.title: BioKinematics Cricket Form Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner at sports-themed hackathons by delivering a highly visual, working browser-based demo.

ideas.pitch: Satellite imagery change detection tuned for Uttarakhand's industrial and forest boundaries to track environmental compliance.
ideas.title: HillStation Eco-Industrial Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Connects directly with regional environmental realities in Dehradun and Uttarakhand, appealing strongly to local academic and industry judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition scanner optimized for regional mess and canteen meals, generating macro breakdowns and wellness tips.
ideas.title: Himalayan Canteen Nutrition AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relies on a proven consumer health hackathon winning formula with immediate everyday utility for students on campus.

ideas.pitch: A statistical and machine learning pipeline predicting campus maintenance bottlenecks and resource crunches based on historical event logs.
ideas.title: Campus Incident AI Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous quantitative modeling and calibration that technical judges at BFIT will immediately respect.
